response.overview: Not In Our Town’s film Minnesota Neighbors profiles the brave actions of Minnesota residents during ICE’s Operation Metro Surge. The film captures the beauty and strength of unity displayed by people from every walk of life who stepped into harsh winter streets at all hours to support their neighbors. Portraits include immigrants bravely speaking up, clergy, journalists, teachers, local officials, doctors, restaurateurs, unions, business owners and families who overcame their own fears to stand up for each other and for our freedoms as Americans.
response.title: Minnesota Neighbors

release_dates.note: World premiere at Riverview Theater in Minneapolis
